prompt: Continue Plan mode after all decision-changing questions have been answered. Reconcile the repository evidence and confirmed decisions into the final dependency-ordered plan, keep implementation files unchanged, synchronize the durable plan note, and emit the readiness marker only if the host validator accepts the complete plan.

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The implementation workspace digest remains unchanged while the final plan and durable plan note are produced.

The final plan contains the required decision summary, current-state evidence, dependency-ordered implementation steps, user/failure states where material, risks/alternatives, acceptance criteria, verification, and remaining assumptions with actionable file/system ownership.
All previously resolved decision-changing questions are reflected consistently in the plan; the plan does not silently reopen, contradict, or replace confirmed decisions.
The durable plan note is synchronized to the final plan/confirmed decisions and remains a usable handoff artifact rather than a stale discovery checkpoint.
The readiness marker appears exactly once and only after the host readiness validator accepts the complete plan.

evidence: randomized candidate and baseline final-plan artifacts
